question: Show Head and Neck trials using PD-L1 where PD‑L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.

gemini.answer: This query returns Head and Neck Cancer (HNSCC) trials using PD-L1 inhibitors where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"cancer_type\", \"ici_class\", \"pdl1_inclusion\" \nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'HNSCC' AND \"ici_class\" = 'PD-L1' AND \"pdl1_inclusion\" = 'Yes';", "answer": "This query returns Head and Neck Cancer (HNSCC) trials using PD-L1 inhibitors where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.", "assumptions": ""}
